question: True or false: calling setCount(5) when count is already 5 makes React skip re-rendering.
say: True or false: calling set count five when count is already five makes React skip the re-render.
explanation: True. Object.is(5, 5) is true, so React skips re-rendering the component and its children.
explainSay: True. The values are identical, so React skips the re-render.
